description:
Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

The Senior Financial Analyst is a key member of the Financial Planning & Analysis team, partnering closely with C-level executives and business leaders to set financial and operational goals and budgets, track performance, and translate results into actionable insights. This role connects financial and operational information across the organization, ensuring the right stakeholders have the context they need to make timely, informed decisions. Success means delivering rigorous forecasts and analysis while helping drive ownership, accountability, and follow-through against Oportun’s financial and strategic objectives.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • Partner with C-level executives and business leaders to develop financial goals, budgets, and forecasts, and track performance against those commitments.
  • Produce monthly and multi-year financial forecasts that provide a clear view of expected performance and support company planning.
  • Analyze P&L performance, explain variances to plan, identify current and emerging trends, and surface risks and opportunities.
  • Perform financial, cost/benefit, and other ad-hoc analyses to support executive decision-making and strategic initiatives.
  • Manage recurring financial and KPI reporting, including clear, decision-ready materials for executives and other key stakeholders.
  • Drive ownership and accountability across the organization by establishing clear financial goals, tracking performance, and ensuring stakeholders understand commitments, risks, and required actions.
  • Connect insights across financial and operational data, identifying relationships and emerging themes and bringing them to the right stakeholders to enable timely, informed decision-making.
  • Bring ideas for how we can do things better—proactively, not just when asked—and look for thoughtful ways to use AI tools to reduce manual work and improve decision-making.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re an intellectually curious, proactive finance professional who enjoys connecting the dots and turning complex information into clear, actionable insights. You combine strong analytical skills and attention to detail with excellent interpersonal skills, allowing you to build credibility and work effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including C-level executives.

You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging assumptions, and moving forward without perfect information. You communicate clearly, exercise sound judgment, and have the confidence to surface risks, opportunities, and differing perspectives when they matter.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

  • 3+ years of experience in finance, FP&A, or a related analytical role; consumer financial services experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, or another analytical discipline.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, including cash flow and three-statement financial modeling.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and detail-oriented capabilities, with a high standard for integrity, accuracy, and precision.
  • Strong interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and work effectively with senior stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Master’s degree in Business (MBA), Finance, or another analytical discipline.
  • Experience partnering directly with senior executives in a planning, budgeting, forecasting, or decision-support capacity.
  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar tools to improve productivity and analysis.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

 

Mexico Benefits: 

  • Medical Insurance
  • Savings Fund and Life Insurance
  • Vacation and Parental Leave
  • Internet and Electricity Allowance

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers   #LI-REMOTE #LI-VR1

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

 

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:  https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/.

 

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).
